intro: Everything below is a known gap, conflict or trap. Nothing in this list has been silently patched: each item states what was found, what was done about it on the site, and what a reviewer should do next.

items.title: Live filter says 5/14/50, the 2025 ceremony article says 5/15/52
items.detail: guide.michelin.com's live 'all starred' filter reported 69 starred restaurants (5 three-star, 14 two-star, 50 one-star) and 76 Bib Gourmand on 2026-11-25. The official ceremony article for the 2025 selection names 5/15/52. The delta is two rows in the two-star tier and two in the one-star tier.
items.effect_on_site: All tables follow the LIVE filter counts (5/14/50), because that is the current public selection; the article is cited separately and the discrepancy is stated on the Michelin page.
items.action: Reconcile by name before publishing: diff the two lists row by row and record which restaurant disappeared and when.

items.title: The 2026 New York stars do not exist yet
items.detail: The next MICHELIN Guide New York ceremony is expected around 14 December 2026, after this research date. Every star on the site is therefore the 2025 selection.
items.effect_on_site: Stated in the page lede and in the executive summary.
items.action: Re-run the starred/bib harvest after the ceremony and regenerate the site from data/restaurants.json.

items.title: Booking.com week totals exclude 14.75% tax plus $4 per night
items.detail: The $848, $943, $1,535, $1,653 and $1,747 totals are displayed before tax. The Eurostars page explicitly showed US$149.66 of tax excluded on top of $848.
items.effect_on_site: Every hotel row carries a tax_note; totals are labelled pre-tax; the executive summary ranks on the displayed total and says so.
items.action: Add a taxed total column (site suggestion S-03) before the price ranking is treated as final.

items.title: The Benjamin's per-night figure does not match its stay total
items.detail: The search result displayed '$174 per night', but the 7-night total was $1,535, which is about $219 per night. Tax treatment on that row was not captured.
items.effect_on_site: Row marked unverified; the total is treated as authoritative and the per-night value is not shown.
items.action: Open the property page for 2027-02-15 to 02-22 and capture the room table directly.

items.title: The cheapest room in a search result is often a twin or a full bed
items.detail: Eurostars' cheapest 2027-02-22 to 03-01 room was a twin at $836 (fails the queen rule). The Frederick's cheapest room was a full bed at $1,607 (also fails).
items.effect_on_site: Only queen-or-larger rows are ranked; the failures are documented in hotels.json under 'excluded'.
items.action: Always open the room table, not the search card.

items.title: @crownshy on Instagram is not Crown Shy
items.detail: instagram.com/crownshy resolves to an account called 'Cutoff' with 4 followers. Likewise instagram.com/jungsik is a personal account ('Jungsik Jin', 24 followers), not the restaurant.
items.effect_on_site: No handle is shown for either; the rows are blank rather than linking a stranger's account.
items.action: Confirm handles by following the link from the restaurant's own website footer, never by guessing the name.

items.title: The Met, NYPL, Katz's and AMNH do not publish hours where expected
items.detail: metmuseum.org's plan-your-visit page prints only garage hours; the public gallery schedule is rendered by a widget. nypl.org says 'see building hours above' but the widget did not render. katzsdelicatessen.com's menu page carries no opening hours. AMNH publishes hours but not ticket prices on that page.
items.effect_on_site: Values left blank with a Flagged chip; no hours were copied from a secondary source.
items.action: Capture these from the venue's own hours endpoint or by phone, then fill the blanks.

items.title: Two Michelin detail pages are still unharvested
items.detail: Crown Shy and Aska appear in the 1-star / 2-star rosters with correct Michelin URLs but without captured hours, address, phone or booking partner.
items.effect_on_site: Their rows link to Michelin but show 'unverified'.
items.action: Fetch guide.michelin.com/en/.../restaurant/crown-shy and /aska and append the values.

items.title: Eleven Madison Park's ZIP code differs between sources
items.detail: data/restaurants.json carried 10019; the Michelin detail page shows 10010. The building is at 11 Madison Avenue.
items.effect_on_site: Not yet corrected in the JSON — the Michelin page value (10010) is the one cited on the site.
items.action: Fix the ZIP in the JSON so the audit trail is clean.

items.title: Only two restaurants have coordinates
items.detail: Le Bernardin and Per Se were geocoded via Nominatim; the rest of the roster has no lat/lon.
items.effect_on_site: No map is drawn; the site uses distance-free transit times instead.
items.action: Geocode the roster if the star-map suggestion (S-07) is adopted.

items.title: All transit times are one weekday-evening sample
items.detail: Every leg was captured 2026-11-25 between 17:14 and 17:31 ET with 'leave now'. February weather, weekend schedules and overnight headways will change some of them.
items.effect_on_site: Stated on the Hotels page and in transit_anchors.json's method note.
items.action: Re-run the legs for the actual trip dates before booking.

items.title: The cheapest rates are a Black Friday promotion, not proof of when to book
items.detail: Several rates were labelled 'Black Friday Deal' with a validity window of 2026-11-19 to 2027-12-31. That is a dated promotion, not evidence that November is the cheapest time to book.
items.effect_on_site: pricing_windows.json sets time_to_book = 'unverified' and explains why.
items.action: If a genuine booking-timing forecast is wanted, it needs historical rate tracking, which was out of scope.

items.title: Bib Gourmand and 'Selected' restaurants are counted but not fully tabled
items.detail: 76 Bib Gourmand and 224 Selected restaurants were counted from the live site, but only the 69 starred restaurants have individual rows.
items.effect_on_site: The counts are shown; the table explains the tier difference.
items.action: Expand the Bib roster if the user wants cheaper dining options included in the ranking.

items.title: The itinerary assumes an afternoon arrival
items.detail: Day 1 places a 17:30 dinner within hours of check-in, which fails if the flight lands late.
items.effect_on_site: Flagged on the Itinerary page (I-04) and in open question Q-FLIGHT.
items.action: Replace day 1 with a low-commitment option once flights are known.
